about: Where the fixture cut-out portraits come from (TASK-79, R5-2). Both are fictional: the AI portrait examples/candidates/fictional-engineer.png with its background removed. The original is pinned in tests/baseline.json and was not changed.

files.fictional-cutout.png: the tool's output, resized from 1200 to 640 px square (Pillow LANCZOS), RGBA kept
files.fictional-cutout-grey.png: fictional-cutout.png with its colour channels set to its luminance (Pillow convert('L')), alpha unchanged; the tool has no grey option
